note: Hardware picker data for the rack builder. Facts policy: server power figures are TDP-formula budgets (ΣGPU + ΣCPU) × 1.2 — the same model as /tdp-to-rack-kw — computed from publicly stated accelerator TDPs; GB200 NVL72 is the vendor-stated rack figure. Cooling products reuse the verified comparison data layer (capacity anchors per row). Never present these as measured draw.
